name: Tea Time with the Princess
source:
It's the brightest moon of the year. That means it's tea time with the princess.

A short, bittersweet story about two lovers from rival sides.

[From [url=https://paletarosa.itch.io/tea-time-with-the-princess]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今夜是一年之中月色最皎洁的圆满之夜。这意味着，又到了与公主共进下午茶的时刻。

一段讲述敌对阵营有情人之间温柔而又苦涩的短篇故事。

[摘自[url=https://paletarosa.itch.io/tea-time-with-the-princess]itch.io[/url]]
